cd /home/daytona/workspace; cat > sweep.py <<'E'
import sys, itertools
from sim.g1.episode import run_episode
res=[]
for x,y,z in itertools.product([0.3,0.38,0.45],[-0.2,-0.1,0.1,0.2],[0.9,1.0,1.1]):
    r,_=run_episode(sys.argv[1],[x,y,z],seed=int(x*100+z*10),record=False)
    res.append(r['success']); 
    if not r['success']: print((x,y,z),r['struck'],r['bag_peak_cm'],r['fell'],r['struck_with'])
print(sum(res),len(res))
E
python3 sweep.py controller.py
cd /home/daytona/workspace; sed -i 's/\[0.3,0.38,0.45\]/[float(a) for a in sys.argv[2].split(",")]/' sweep.py; python3 sweep.py controller.py 0.45

cd /home/daytona/workspace; python3 - <<'E'
import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from sim.g1 import episode
import controller
orig=controller.Controller.act
def act(self,obs):
    a=orig(self,obs)
    t=obs['time']
    if 1.0<t<1.9 and int(round(t*50))%3==0:
        print(round(t,2),'hand',obs[self.side].round(3),'tgt',self.hand_target(t).round(3),'bag',obs['bag_pos'].round(3))
    return a
controller.Controller.act=act
r,_=episode.run_episode('controller.py',[0.45,-0.1,0.9],seed=3,record=False)
E

cd /home/daytona/workspace; sed 's/        t = obs\["time"\]/        t = obs["time"]\n        if 1.0<t<1.9 and int(round(t*50))%3==0: print(round(t,2),obs[self.side].round(3),self.hand_target(t).round(3),obs["bag_pos"].round(3))/' controller.py > /tmp/dbg.py; python3 -m sim.g1.run --controller /tmp/dbg.py --bag 0.45,-0.1,0.9 --seed 3 | head -30

cd /home/daytona/workspace; free -m | head -2; cat > sweep.sh <<'E'
#!/bin/bash
# usage: sweep.sh xs ; runs each in own process
for x in $1; do for y in -0.2 -0.1 0.1 0.2; do for z in 0.9 1.0 1.1; do
python3 -m sim.g1.run --controller controller.py --bag $x,$y,$z --seed 5 | python3 -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print('$x,$y,$z', r['success'], r['bag_peak_cm'], r['fell'], r['struck_with'])"
done; done; done
E
chmod +x sweep.sh; ./sweep.sh 0.45 2>&1 | tail -15
